# React Chatbox Chrome Extension with MCP Connection

This is a Chrome extension project built with React that implements a chatbox with Model Context Protocol (MCP) connection to a backend server.

When suggesting code for this project:
- Follow Chrome Extension Manifest V3 best practices
- Use React functional components with hooks
- Implement the MCP specification for connecting to the backend
- Follow modern JavaScript/TypeScript best practices
- Optimize for performance and accessibility
